subject: Re: MAP & Milestone-linked Commercials / Observability retention and Support bundle
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearsight.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP ask + evaluation timeline

Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Priya and I regrouped and want to lock the MAP and a commercialization path tied to the MAP milestones before we proceed with a production eval. High level asks:

- Confirm a 12‑week evaluation MAP with three milestone gates (PoC week 3, stability/ramp week 7, scale test week 12).
- Pricing commitment options tied to MAP outcomes (trial → pilot → reserved commit). We want transparent uplift/discount bands so we can budget for Q2.
- Observability: we need two retention tiers in the proposal — 30d (default) and 90d (add-on).
- Premium support: clarify SLA and time-to-response for Sev1 / Sev2 under an evaluation-to-pilot path.

Can you send a MAP spreadsheet and a commercial outline that ties discounts to ramp/commit thresholds? Also attach any SOW draft if available.

Thanks — looking to close vendor selection by 2026-02-12.

—Liam
Liam Carter
VP Engineering, ClearSight Analytics
liam.carter@clearsight.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearsight.io>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearsight.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask + evaluation timeline

Liam / Priya —

Appreciate the clarity. Sending an initial MAP + commercial approach in the attached MAP_Clearsight_v1.xlsx and a SOW draft. Key points summarized below so it's easier to review:

MAP (12 weeks, three gates)
- Week 0–3: Onboard + PoC (deliverable: integration success + 1 benchmark scenario).
- Week 4–7: Stability & latency targets (deliverable: sustained throughput at target latency).
- Week 8–12: Scale test & cost projection (deliverable: 100k tokens/day test run or agreed workload).

Commercial structure (linked to MAP gates)
- Evaluation (no commit): hosted API access with capped tokens; standard 30d retention; optional paid premium support add-on.
- Pilot (post-PoC success): 3 month pilot with 25% discount on hosted list; includes 60d retention and 10k observability credits.
- Reserved (post-scale success / commit): 12‑month reserved commit with stepped discounts based on committed QPS / tokens. Example bands: 250k/mo -> 15% off, 1M/mo -> 25% off.

Add‑ons & Bundles
- Observability retention: base 30d included; 90d retention as an add-on priced at $X per 100k tokens retained/month (see sheet).
- Premium Support bundle: 24/7 coverage, 1‑hour Sev1 SLA, quarterly review — available as add-on or part of pilot at a discounted rate.
- Credits bundle: evaluation includes 5k observability credits; pilot upsell includes +10k.

Next steps: 
1) Review MAP sheet and commercial bands — confirm which commit band you'd target under Reserved so we can draft final SOW.
2) If you want a small concession on pilot pricing to accelerate close, let me know the specific budget target and I'll coordinate with Evelyn.

I've attached the MAP and SOW draft. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk details.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask + evaluation timeline

Karthik — quick notes on concessions:

- We can offer the pilot at 30% off list (instead of 25%) if ClearSight commits to a 6‑month rollout plan and a conversation about reserved sizing by week 9.
- 90d retention add‑on: pricing floor is firm but we can include the first month free as part of the pilot bundle.
- Premium Support escalation: can include 1‑hour Sev1 in pilot for an incremental flat fee (not %).

If they're pushing to sign by 02/12, the 30% pilot discount + first month 90d retention free is a reasonable commercial to accelerate. If Karthik thinks they need more, escalate to me with expected ARR.

—Evelyn
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearsight.io>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearsight.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 11:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Milestone-linked Commercials / Observability retention and Support bundle

Liam / Priya —

Following up with a refined commercial:

- Pilot: 3 months at 30% off list (includes 60d retention and +10k observability credits). First month of 90d retention included at no charge.
- Reserved commit: table in MAP shows stepped discounts — if you commit to >=500k tokens/mo for 12 months we can move to 20% off reserved pricing; >=1M tokens/mo gets 28% off.
- Premium Support: Pilot add-on flat fee $7,500/mo with 1‑hour Sev1 SLA and a named TAM.

Attached SOW highlights acceptance criteria tied to each MAP gate. If that looks acceptable we'll prepare a pilot order form and DocuSign. You mentioned needing procurement review — suggest we include a short mutual acceptance clause so procurement can sign off on pilot deliverables.

Can we get final confirmation by 02/10 so we can ship the PO template and DocuSign link the following day?

Thanks — Karthik
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearsight.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearsight.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Milestone-linked Commercials / Observability retention and Support bundle

Karthik / Evelyn —

Thanks — we reviewed with procurement and legal. Agreed to the pilot economics and the 30% pilot discount. Two small asks before signature: 

1) Add a 30‑day SLA review milestone after week 7 (so we lock in reserved sizing conversation).
2) Change the SOW acceptance note to explicitly list the benchmark scenario and test dataset (we'll provide dataset details).

If you can update the SOW and share a DocuSign link, we'll route for signature this week. Assuming that, next steps: DocuSign -> PO -> kickoff the week after signature.

We're good to move forward.

—Priya
Head of Platform, ClearSight Analytics
